note: GHSA-mwqv-cfjv-p4cc: scripts/walk-dir.mjs used Dirent.isDirectory(), which describes a symlink/junction ENTRY itself, never its target -- a symlinked source directory fell into neither the directory branch nor the .move-suffix branch and was silently dropped, while sui move build's own walker follows links and compiles it. Fixed by resolving a link entry (realpathSync.native + statSync, matching the compiler's follow_links(true) semantics) and recursing into it when the target is a directory. A symlink cycle terminates via a Set of visited REAL paths rather than blowing the stack; a link whose target cannot be resolved is a hard error at every depth (never a silent skip -- that would be a second instance of the exact defect this fix closes), deliberately NOT the same contract as the existing root-throws/non-root-swallows readdirSync error handling, which is for a whole unreadable subdirectory rather than one named, enumerated, unresolvable entry. All fixtures use Windows directory junctions (fs.symlinkSync(target, path, 'junction')), which need no elevated privilege, so the test never requires an elevated shell.
